verdict.rationale: vLLM is designed to run on your own infrastructure. Users can install it with uv or pip, build it from source on GitHub, or deploy the official vllm/vllm-openai Docker image, then start an OpenAI-compatible server via the CLI on a wide range of hardware. Community reports of building production systems on top of vLLM corroborate this. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence.
